nodes.description: Advanced/metastatic clear-cell renal cell carcinoma is treated with an immune-checkpoint-inhibitor-based combination, generally favored in intermediate/poor-risk disease by IMDC criteria, or with tyrosine-kinase inhibitor monotherapy.
